source_note: Compiled from official notices and mainstream reporting. Every card links to its original source.

items.title: Canada study visa rules change: Students must show more funds from September 1
items.summary: Canada is changing study visa requirements from September 1, requiring students to demonstrate higher financial resources. Indian students planning to study in Canada will need to meet the new, increased proof of funds threshold when applying for their study permits.

items.title: US Green Card new rule: Indians seeking PR could face wider scrutiny from Sept 18
items.summary: A new rule taking effect from September 18 may subject Indian applicants seeking US permanent residence to broader scrutiny during the Green Card application process. The change could affect how applications are reviewed and processed for Indian nationals.

items.title: US Green Card new rules take effect September 18: What Indian applicants need to know
items.summary: New US Green Card regulations come into force on September 18, bringing changes that will impact Indian applicants. Those seeking permanent residence in the United States should understand how these updated rules affect their application process and requirements.

items.title: UK study visas fall 16%: New rules, fewer dependants and what's changed
items.summary: UK study visa applications have dropped by 16 percent, attributed to new regulations and restrictions on bringing dependants. The changes reflect tightened policies affecting international students, including those from India, who wish to study in the United Kingdom.

items.title: New Zealand to introduce new 6-month graduate work visa from this year
items.summary: New Zealand will launch a new six-month graduate work visa later this year. The visa is designed for recent graduates and will have specific eligibility criteria that applicants, including Indian graduates, will need to meet to work in New Zealand after completing their studies.

items.title: JD Vance backs $100,000 fee for H-1B visas to protect US workers
items.summary: JD Vance has expressed support for a proposed $100,000 fee on H-1B visas, arguing the programme should not be used to replace American workers. This proposal, if implemented, would significantly increase costs for employers sponsoring H-1B visa holders, including many Indian professionals.

items.title: What are the 3 major US visa modifications impacting students and green card applicants?
items.summary: Three significant changes to US visa regulations are now affecting both international students and Green Card applicants. These modifications introduce new requirements and procedures that Indian students and those seeking permanent residence in the United States need to understand and follow.

items.title: US court blocks Trump administration's four-year visa rule for international students
items.summary: A US court has blocked a Trump administration rule that would have imposed a four-year limit on visas for international students and researchers. The court decision prevents the implementation of this restriction, maintaining current visa duration policies for students studying in America.

items.title: Three major US visa modifications affecting students and green card applicants
items.summary: The United States has introduced three significant visa changes that will impact international students and those applying for green cards. The modifications affect visa processing and requirements for Indian applicants seeking to study or obtain permanent residency in America.

items.title: UK cuts Graduate visa duration to 18 months; how students can still secure 2 years
items.summary: The United Kingdom has reportedly reduced the Graduate visa duration to 18 months. However, international students may still be able to secure a two-year post-study work period through alternative routes or specific conditions.

items.title: H-1B shortage, rising costs and delays: 7 US immigration challenges in 2026
items.summary: Seven major challenges are affecting US immigration in 2026, including H-1B visa shortages, increasing costs, and processing delays. These issues impact Indian professionals and others seeking to work in the United States through employment-based visa programmes.

items.title: UK study visa applications fall 16% in year to August 2026
items.summary: Study visa applications to the UK have declined by 16 percent in the year ending August 2026. The drop reflects changing patterns in international student applications to British universities, potentially influenced by recent policy changes affecting students from India and other countries.

items.title: US court restores H-4 EAD automatic extensions for spouses
items.summary: A United States court has restored automatic employment authorization extensions for H-4 visa holders, the spouses of H-1B workers. The ruling benefits Indian visa holders whose spouses can now continue working while their work permits are being renewed.

items.title: Indians not on English test exemption list as Australia visa refusals hit 10-year high
items.summary: Indian students are not included on Australia's English language test exemption list, even as student visa refusals have reached their highest level in ten years. The requirement adds an additional hurdle for Indian applicants seeking Australian study visas.

items.title: International students in US face fixed stay limits from September 15
items.summary: International students in the United States, including Indians, will face fixed duration-of-status limits starting September 15. The new rule changes how long students can remain in the country on their study visas.

items.title: Canada to introduce new Express Entry platform: What Indian applicants need to know
items.summary: Canada is launching a new Express Entry platform that will change how Indian applicants apply for permanent residency. The updated system will introduce modifications to the application process for skilled workers seeking immigration.

items.title: Why Indians are turning to the $800,000 EB-5 route for US Green Card
items.summary: Indian applicants are increasingly choosing the EB-5 investor visa programme, which requires an investment of 800,000 dollars, as an alternative route to obtain a US Green Card. Experts suggest the H-1B pathway alone may be insufficient for permanent residency.

items.title: Canada's Express Entry getting new digital platform with Expression of Interest system
items.summary: Canada's Express Entry immigration system is reported to be receiving a new digital platform that will include an Expression of Interest system. The changes are expected to affect how Indian applicants submit their permanent residence applications.

items.title: Trump administration could end 60-day grace period for laid-off H-1B workers
items.summary: The Trump administration is reported to be considering ending the 60-day grace period currently available to H-1B workers who lose their jobs. This safety net allows laid-off workers time to find new employment or change status.

items.title: Over 40% of Indian student visa applications rejected by Australia
items.summary: A report indicates that more than 40 per cent of student visa applications from India to Australia are being rejected. The high refusal rate represents a significant challenge for Indian students seeking to study in Australia.

items.title: Indians can visit UAE without local employer under jobseeker visa
items.summary: Indians can now visit the United Arab Emirates to search for employment without requiring a local employer or sponsor, using a jobseeker visa. The report outlines eligibility criteria and rules for this visa category.

items.title: US immigration rule changes raise new risks
items.summary: New immigration rule changes in the United States are creating additional risks for applicants. The modifications to existing regulations are expected to impact those seeking to immigrate or work in the country.

items.title: Over 40% of Indian student visa applications rejected by Australia
items.summary: More than 40 per cent of student visa applications from India to Australia are being rejected, according to a recent report. The refusal rate represents a significant challenge for Indian students seeking to study in Australia.

items.title: Australia student visa refusal rate hits 10-year high, India faces tough scrutiny
items.summary: Australia's student visa refusal rate has reached its highest level in ten years. Indian and Nepali applicants are reportedly facing particularly tough scrutiny during the visa assessment process.

items.title: UK student visa applications down 16% as August peak drops below 100k
items.summary: Student visa applications to the UK have fallen by sixteen percent. For the first time, the August peak period saw applications drop below one hundred thousand, marking a significant decline in demand.

items.title: New Zealand visa update for Indian travellers: Changes from 1 October 2026
items.summary: New Zealand is introducing visa changes for Indian travellers that will take effect from 1 October 2026. Details of the specific modifications have been announced for those planning to visit the country.

items.title: EB-1 Green Card risk grows for Indians as US visa numbers near annual limit
items.summary: Indians applying for EB-1 Green Cards face growing risk as US visa numbers approach the annual limit. This development could affect processing and availability for Indian applicants in this employment-based category.

items.title: Australia MATES Visa 2026: Eligibility, requirements, cost and how to apply
items.summary: Information has been published about Australia's MATES Visa for 2026, covering eligibility criteria, requirements, associated costs and the application process for this visa category.

items.title: Indians can visit UAE to seek jobs without local employer or sponsor
items.summary: Indian citizens can now travel to the UAE to look for employment without requiring a local employer or sponsor beforehand. The jobseeker visa provides an opportunity to search for work while in the Emirates.

items.title: Australia student visa rejections surge, Indian applicants hit hard
items.summary: Student visa rejection rates in Australia have increased significantly, with Indian applicants particularly affected by the tougher approval standards. The surge represents a notable shift in Australia's student visa processing for Indian nationals.

items.title: New Zealand expands post-study work visa and launches 6-month graduate visa
items.summary: New Zealand is expanding eligibility for its Post-Study Work Visa and introducing a new six-month graduate work visa starting 16 November. The changes open up more work pathways for international graduates who have studied in New Zealand.

items.title: Trump moves to scrap H-1B visa 60-day grace period for Indian workers
items.summary: The Trump administration is reportedly moving to eliminate the 60-day grace period currently available to H-1B visa holders. This change would create new risks for Indian workers on H-1B visas who lose their jobs or need to transition between employers.

items.title: Indians face growing US immigration hurdles under Trump administration
items.summary: Employees, students, dependants and visitors from India are reportedly facing increased immigration challenges in the United States under the Trump administration. The hurdles affect multiple visa categories for Indian nationals.

items.title: US visa laws applied consistently worldwide, State Department says
items.summary: The US State Department has stated that visa laws are being applied consistently across all countries worldwide, responding to concerns about H-1B visa processing. The clarification addresses questions raised about potential differential treatment.

items.title: US suspends Cognizant's Green Card filings under PERM programme
items.summary: The United States has suspended Cognizant's ability to file green card applications through the PERM labour certification programme. The suspension affects Indian workers employed by the company who are seeking permanent residency.

items.title: New Zealand ends paper visa applications for several categories from October
items.summary: New Zealand will discontinue paper-based visa applications for multiple visa categories starting in October. Applicants will need to use online application systems instead of submitting physical paperwork for these visa types.

items.title: Indians face growing US immigration hurdles under Trump administration
items.summary: Indian employees, students, dependants and visitors are reportedly encountering increased difficulties with US immigration processes under the Trump administration. The nature and extent of these hurdles affecting multiple visa categories is not specified in the report.

items.title: New Zealand to end paper visa applications for several categories in October
items.summary: From October, New Zealand will stop accepting paper applications for several visa categories, moving to digital-only processing. The change affects multiple visa types but specific categories are not listed in the report.

items.title: Canada allows foreign workers to take short courses without study permit
items.summary: Canada has eased study rules for foreign workers already in the country, permitting them to enrol in short courses without obtaining a separate study permit. This change simplifies access to training and education for temporary workers.

items.title: Indian students rethink the American dream amid visa uncertainty
items.summary: Indian students are reconsidering their plans to study in the United States due to growing uncertainty around visa policies. The changing immigration landscape is causing prospective students to evaluate their options more carefully before committing to American universities.

items.title: New Zealand visitor visa rules to change from October 2026
items.summary: New Zealand will introduce changes to visitor visa rules starting in October 2026. The specific nature of the rule changes has not been detailed in the report.

items.title: Cognizant suspends green card filings in US: Impact on workers
items.summary: Cognizant has suspended green card filings in the United States, which will affect workers employed by the company who were expecting employer-sponsored permanent residency applications. The suspension raises questions about the implications for current and prospective employees seeking long-term immigration status.

items.title: Trump's H-1B crackdown impacts Indian IT industry
items.summary: The H-1B visa crackdown under the Trump administration is affecting the Indian IT industry. While the measures are creating challenges for Indian technology workers and companies, the report suggests the industry had anticipated these restrictions and may have prepared accordingly.

items.title: US EB-1 green card category may become unavailable for Indians before September ends
items.summary: The EB-1 employment-based green card category for Indians is likely to become unavailable before September 30. This would affect Indian applicants seeking permanent residency through this priority category during the current fiscal year.

items.title: Canada announces student visa changes for 2026 affecting funds, PAL and co-op
items.summary: Canada has introduced changes to student visa rules for 2026 covering financial requirements, Provincial Attestation Letters and co-op programme regulations. The specific details of these changes are not outlined in the report.

items.title: Credit checks may impact US green card applicants and sponsors
items.summary: Credit checks could affect both green card applicants and their sponsors in the United States. The report suggests this financial scrutiny may add a new dimension to the permanent residency application process.

items.title: Canada study permit 2026: Higher funds, tighter scrutiny and new norms announced
items.summary: Canada has announced changes to study permit requirements for 2026, including increased financial proof requirements, stricter application scrutiny and new regulations for international students. The specific amounts and detailed norms are not provided.

items.title: Australian student visa refusals reach 10-year high
items.summary: Student visa refusals in Australia have hit their highest level in a decade, affecting applicants' educational plans. The report describes the situation as shattering dreams but does not specify refusal rates or reasons.

items.title: India introduces biometric kiosks to speed up immigration for e-Visa travellers
items.summary: India has deployed biometric kiosks at immigration checkpoints to accelerate processing for travellers arriving on e-Visas. The new system aims to reduce wait times and streamline entry procedures at Indian airports.

items.title: UK immigration rules changing from October: Five major updates
items.summary: The United Kingdom is implementing changes to its immigration rules starting in October. The report highlights five major updates that will affect visa applicants. Those planning to apply for UK visas should familiarize themselves with the new requirements taking effect next month.

items.title: US visa interviews available in 10 days for $750 fee
items.summary: A new US visa update allows applicants to schedule visa interviews within ten days by paying a fee of 750 dollars. This expedited service option may benefit those needing urgent appointments, though it comes at a significant additional cost beyond standard application fees.

items.title: US warns EB-1 green card category for Indians may run out before September 30
items.summary: The United States has issued an alert that the EB-1 green card category may be exhausted before the end of September. This affects Indian applicants seeking permanent residence through the employment-based first preference route, which typically serves priority workers.

items.title: US reportedly weighing H-1B changes including grace period and H-4 work authorization
items.summary: The United States is reportedly considering modifications to H-1B visa rules that could affect grace periods for job changes, fee structures and employment authorization for H-4 dependent visa holders. These potential changes would impact Indian workers and their families in America.

items.title: How Indians on US tourist visas can extend their stay using Form I-539
items.summary: Indians visiting the United States on tourist visas can apply to extend their stay using Form I-539. The process involves specific timing requirements and procedures for those wishing to remain longer than their initial authorized period.

items.title: Trump administration reportedly considering stricter H-1B and student visa rules
items.summary: The Trump administration is reportedly weighing tighter regulations for H-1B work visas, green cards, and student visas. These potential changes could significantly affect Indian applicants across multiple visa categories if implemented.

items.title: New Zealand student visa processing times for 2027 intake
items.summary: Information about student visa processing times for New Zealand has been released for students planning to begin studies in 2027. The update provides guidance for Indian students preparing applications for New Zealand educational institutions.

items.title: Can Indians work in Canada on a visitor visa? Rules on jobs and penalties explained
items.summary: The article clarifies Canadian regulations regarding employment on visitor visas. It explains what work is permitted, when separate work permits are required, and the penalties Indians may face for working illegally while in Canada on visitor status without proper authorization.

items.title: UK student visa fees increasing from November 2026 for Indian applicants
items.summary: The cost of obtaining a UK student visa will rise starting November 2026. Indian students planning to study in the United Kingdom need to factor in these higher fees when budgeting for their education abroad and preparing their visa applications.

items.title: UAE Golden Visa eligibility: What Indians need to know about the ₹5 crore threshold
items.summary: The article examines whether an investment of five crore rupees qualifies Indians for the UAE Golden Visa programme. It covers eligibility criteria, rules and benefits of this long-term residency scheme for investors and professionals seeking to settle in the Emirates.

items.title: H-1B visa fees could exceed $200,000 under reported Trump administration proposal
items.summary: A proposal under consideration by the Trump administration could raise H-1B visa fees to over two hundred thousand dollars. This potential increase would significantly impact Indian tech workers and their employers who sponsor these employment-based visas, though the change is not yet confirmed.
